# Set up the CI test jobs

> **ID:** WI-2026-11-21-001 | **Status:** queue

## Description

Create the CI jobs and tests on the existing OneDev server (AlmaLinux 9, `onedev.eusou.dev.br`), without creating or provisioning any machine. This covers container tests on OneDev's Docker executor over Podman, the job that mirrors the repository to GitHub as a read-only copy, and GitHub Actions runs for Windows, macOS, Android and iOS whose results are reported back in OneDev. Product tests come with later items.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] added: A 3-node rqlite test (kill one node, a new Leader is elected) runs as a OneDev job on the Docker executor over Podman.
- [ ] added: A OneDev job pushes each updated branch and tag to the GitHub mirror, authenticated by a token stored as a job secret, without force-push.
- [ ] added: A hello-world build on each GitHub Actions platform (Windows, macOS, Android, iOS) runs on push to the mirror.
- [ ] added: A OneDev job waits for the GitHub run of the same commit and fails when that run fails, so OneDev shows every platform's result.
